newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-Chartwell Leisure Q2 profit vs loss.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Chartwell Leisure Q2 profit vs loss.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: -- Company stated pro forma earnings per share for Q2 1996 as loss of $0.70 a share, or loss of $6.9 million.
Company stated pro forma earnings for past six months ending June 30 1996 as loss of $0.99 a share, or loss of $9.8 million.

Company says pro forma results reflecting its entry into lodging business through its acquisition of 115 Travelodge hotels on Jan 23, 1996, and the subsequent acquisition of 21 Travelodge hotels in Canada on October 1, 1996 occured as of Jan 1, 1996.
Company says as of June 30, it has roughly $82.3 million of outstanding long term deb and roughlyb $51.2 million in cash. Company says it has $70 million available under current credit facility.
